name: AutoFillCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Auto Fill Range in Excel Worksheet
description: Copies data from a source range to a target range in the specified or active worksheet of an Excel workbook.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet to use. If not provided, the active worksheet will be used.

fields.name: RangesFormat
fields.label: Ranges Format
fields.description: Specifies how ranges are defined: by specific ranges or named cells.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the source range (e.g., 'A').

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the source range (e.g., '1').

fields.name: SourceEndColumn
fields.label: Source End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the source range (e.g., 'B').

fields.name: SourceEndRow
fields.label: Source End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the source range (e.g., '5').

fields.name: DestinationEndColumn
fields.label: Destination End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the target range (e.g., 'C').

fields.name: DestinationEndRow
fields.label: Destination End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the target range (e.g., '10').

fields.name: SourceCellsName
fields.label: Source Cells Name
fields.description: The name of the named range containing the source data.

fields.name: DestinationCellsName
fields.label: Destination Cells Name
fields.description: The name of the named range where the data should be pasted.
